text.en:
The provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the number of positions and the
annual salaries of Solicitors and Trial Attorneys are hereby fixed as follows:
PositionsSalaries
Six (6) SolicitorsP28,000.00
Six (6) Solicitors 26,500.00
Six (6) Solicitors 25,000.00
Six (6) Solicitors 23,500.00
Five (5) Solicitors 22,300.00
Three (3) Solicitors 21,200.00
Three (3) Solicitors 20,000.00
Three (3) Solicitors 18,800.00
Four (4) Solicitors 17,600.00
Three (3) Trial Attorneys14,000.00
Three (3) Trial Attorneys12,500.00
Three (3) Trial Attorneys11,000.00
Three (3) Trial Attorneys10,800.00
Three (3) Trial Attorneys9,600.00
Two (2) Trial Attorneys8,400.00

The Office of the Solicitor General shall be exempt from the coverage and the classification and
compensation plans of the Wage and Position Classification Office (WAPCO). The salaries of members of its
Administrative Staff are hereby restored to the same amounts provided under Republic Act No. 6458.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated
such sums as may be necessary to pay the salary increases provided for in Section 1 hereof and thereafter the

funds needed to implement the provisions of this Decree shall be in the annual Appropriation Act.

The salary increases herein provided shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
